title: Nurse Chanthason (Lomaru District Health Center, Onesa)
description: Persona for J3: the nurse at Lomaru District Health Center in Onesa (Country B), on the clinic's tablet (OHS app, facility configuration). Makes the clinical call when a foreign product has no mapping. Fictional.

persona.name: Chanthason
persona.goal: Trust foreign records enough to avoid repeating or missing vaccines.

Foreign vaccines translated to the Onesan schedule
Automatic calculation of what is due next
